companyFieldUpdates.description: Orange Barrel Media, LLC develops and operates landmark static, digital and experiential out-of-home media infrastructure in partnership with cities and real-estate owners. The company serves advertisers, municipalities and property stakeholders across more than 30 U.S. cities and reports offices in Columbus, New York and Los Angeles. DigitalBridge invested through DigitalBridge Partners III during 2025; public sources do not disclose the exact closing date, purchase price, seller, ownership percentage, rollover or acquisition vehicle. IKE Smart City is a separate sister operating company rather than an OBM alias. InfraBridge is not a direct owner, and no later direct OBM sale or signed pending exit was identified through August 19, 2026.
